examples.name: Night Shift
examples.description: A third-person survival night: collect before dawn, and stay ahead of what the dark brings.

examples.name: Hollow Keep
examples.description: A one-level souls-like: stamina combat, rolls, lock-on, bonfires, a fog gate and a two-phase boss. Placeholder art, real mechanics — see SOULS_DEMO.md to swap in your own.

examples.name: Valley
examples.description: Hollow Keep, outdoors: the same souls-like combat and bonfire on a 2 km mountain valley — landscape layers for ground, rock, snow, forest floor and trails, meadow grass and flowers, pine forest, moss rocks, a thatched hamlet with breakable barrels, and a skull cave that loads a second scene.
